notes: Sellers who cannot produce a 3D file can now ask the CUFMAI team to model the pair — a ruler measurement taken from the product's own actions, and the team does the rest
The ask lands in a queue that names who has taken it, and it can only be closed against a model that is already live on that product
Both endings reach the seller in the team's own words — ready, or why it could not be made — on the notification bell, and tapping the notice opens that product
Ships ready and dark: the request flow is switched on with the team's next rollout, so nothing changes for customers in this build
